RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 10, 2003/Agrahayana 19, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;
Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
Small villages and towns  connected
with Highways
*121. SHRI DINA NATH MISHRA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the length of roads constructed
during the period 1998 to 2003;
(b) the number of villages and small
towns connected with Highways through
metalled roads during1998 to 2003;
(c) whether any study has been
conducted to measure progress made,
consequent upon construction of roads
connecting small villages and towns with
State/National Highways; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Cases of corruption in
Bureaucracy
*122. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
Minister of PERSONNEL, PUBLIC
GRIEVANCES AND PENSIONS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases registered
against corrupt officials in the Central
Government during last five years, giving
details year-wise;
(b) the total amount involved; and
(c) the action taken to punish the guilty
officials?
Implementation of Handlooms
(Reservation of Articles for
Production) Act
*123. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the handloom sector in the
country is in tatters;
(b) whether focus on exports is
responsible for the decline in the handloom
sector;
(c) whether it is a fact that the
Handlooms (Reservation of Articles for
Production) Act can not be implemented
because of some technicalities re sorted to
by mills and powerlooms; and
(d) if so, the efforts Government
propose to make to revive the handloom
sector?

Budget limit for implementation of
Swajaldhara scheme
†*124. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any budget limit has been
fixed for each State for the implementation
of 'Swajaldhara' drinking water project;
(b) maximum cost-limit of such a single
project; and
(c) the benefit received by each State
under 'Rashtriya Swajaldhara Yojana',
State-wise details thereof?
Private coal mining
*125. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI ABANI ROY:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring about legislative changes allowing
private mining while liberalizing norms for
allotment of captive blocks for trading in
coal; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Registration of dowry cases
*126. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Delhi Police had issued
circular/instructions that a case of dowry
can not be registered without inquiry from
the Crime Against Women Cell;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the cases registered district-wise and
year-wise after 1999 without inquiry by the
Crime Against Women Cell and the reasons
therefor; and
(d) the number of cases which had been
registered after 7 years of marriage?
Business in foreign countries by
NTPC
†*127. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have permitted NTPC for business in
foreign countries;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) the reasons for the permission; and
(d) whether NTPC has fulfilled its
domestic obligation in the field of power
generation?
Mineral deposits in Orissa
*128. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) the estimated total mineral deposits
in Orissa and how many mines are under
the control of Government undertakings
and how many of them have been given to
private companies; and
(b) whether Government propose to
lease more mines in Orissa to private
companies; if so, the details thereof?
Modernisation of Police by
Andhra Pradesh
*129. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
SHRI RUMANDLA
RAAMACHANDRAYYA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the r equests made by the Andhra
Pradesh Government for sanctioning of
equipment for police modernisation;

Guidelines by Power Grid
Corporation
*130. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Power Grid Corporation
of India has drawn up guidelines for the
States overdrawing their requirements of
power when the system frequency is less
than 49 htz.;
(b) whether there is any provision to
penalise erring states causing grid collapse;
and
(c) whether the guidelines will prove a
deterrent against overdrawal and ensure grid
discipline?

Total number of questions—144
Production of good quality coal
†793. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of good quality coal i.e. A&B
grade is less as compared to its demand in
the country;
(b) if so, the quantity of coal of above
mentioned grades produced in the country
during the years 1990-91 and 2000-2001;
and
(c) the measures taken by Government
to increase the production of aforesaid coal
grades from 1998 till date and the grade-
wise quantity of coal reserve available in
the country?
J.V. operation of coal mining units
with private sector
794. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
one dozen small coal mining units in
different States are operating through joint
venture with the private sector while the
Bill for privatization of coal mining is
awaiting Parliamentary approval; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Closing down of ECL mines
795. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that at least 26
mines in Eastern Coal Fields are to be closed
down on grounds of unviability;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of corrective steps taken
or proposed to be taken in this regard while
safeguarding the thousands of workers’
livelihood?
Grading and pricing of coal
796. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
policy for grading and pricing of coal on
the basis of gross calorific value as opposed
to the concept of useful heat value; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

173
WIN2/NSESSION\3663RSW 173
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Purchase and import of machinery
by C.I.L.
797. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the machinery
purchased and imported by Coal India Ltd.
during last three years;
(b) out of this, the purchase made by
Western Coal Field Ltd.;
(c) whether the machinery purchased
has been put in use or still laying idle in the
godowns;
(d) the details thereof alongwith the
reasons for not using the purchased
machinery; and
(e) the money spent on purchase of
these machinery?
Upgradation of deep penetration
Jaguar Fighters
798. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of present status with
regards to upgradation of deep penetration
Jaguar Fighters and Jaguar Trainers
indigenously by Hindustan Aeronautics
Ltd., Bangalore;
(b) the details of present status with
regards to upgradation of Jaguar proto-type
with the navigation and weapon attack sub-
system indigenously by HAL and Defence
Avionics Research Establishment;
(c) whether Government has released
sufficient funds for these projects;
(d) if so, details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Contract for refit of a naval ship
799. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Naval
Dockyard, Mumbai awarded a contract
relating to refit of a naval ship;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the contract was awarded
to a private shipyard whose rates were not
lowest nor documents complete; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Sainik schools in Uttar Pradesh
†800. DR. AKHTAR HASAN RIZVI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of sainik schools in Uttar
Pradesh, district-wise; and
(b) whether Government are considering
to open more sainik schools in Uttar
Pradesh?
Crash of an IAF aircraft near
Hyderabad
801. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether an Indian Air Force aircraft
crashed near Hyderabad on the
6th November, 2003;
(b) the number of pilots and others, if
any, who lost their lives as a result thereof;
(c) whether an inquiry into the crash
has been held; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and action
taken by Government thereon?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

production; and
(d) if so, the reasons for undertaking
this project?
IAF air show at Srinagar
805. SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Air
Force organised an air show at Srinagar in
July, 2003 for general public there;
(b) whether a recruitment drive of
airmen was also launched on the occasion;
(c) if so, the response of youth of the
Kashmir Valley; and
(d) the number of persons selected for
Air Force?
Defence production unit in Gujarat
